questions.stimulus: Extract A details cost and revenue figures for VisionSpring production.
questions.question_text: Using Extract A, calculate the profit per pair of glasses made by VisionSpring. Show your working.
questions.mark_scheme: 1 mark for identifying revenue per unit, 1 mark for total costs per unit, 2 marks for correct subtraction and final value.

questions.stimulus: Extracts outline projected cash flows for new automated machinery.
questions.question_text: Assess the usefulness of investment appraisal methods (such as Payback or ARR) when deciding on new production technology.
questions.mark_scheme: AO1 (2 marks) Knowledge of methods. AO2 (2 marks) Contextual application to manufacturing. AO3 (4 marks) Analysis of quantitative reliability vs qualitative limitations. AO4 (4 marks) Balanced conclusion.
